title: AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPIC AND PARALYMPIC GAMES REPORT relative to a report on the status of planning for the LA28 Cultural Olympiad.
text:
[Council File 15-0989-S73]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPIC AND PARALYMPIC GAMES REPORT relative to a report on the status of planning for the LA28 Cultural Olympiad.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Rodriguez - Padilla):
DIRECT the Department of Cultural Affairs, with assistance from the City Administrative Officer (CAO), the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and the assistance of the Mayor's Office, and in consultation with LA28 and other appropriate stakeholders, to report within 60 days on the status of planning for the LA28 Cultural Olympiad.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the CAO nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council asks the Department of Cultural Affairs to report within 60 days on the status of planning for the LA28 Cultural Olympiad.

details.action: report request on Cultural Olympiad planning

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 13, 2026); Council action final
